name: Grounds For Divorce
overview: Scripture establishes marriage as a sacred union where a man and woman become one flesh, as seen in Genesis 2:24. While Deuteronomy 24:1 permits divorce under certain conditions related to 'uncleanness,' the Lord expresses His hatred for putting away a spouse in Malachi 2:16, warning against treachery in the marriage covenant. Jesus clarifies in Matthew 5:31-32 and Matthew 19:3 that divorce is not lawful for just any cause, but only for the specific reason of sexual immorality, emphasizing the seriousness of marital faithfulness and the consequences of divorce.
